summary: The name gdpr is rejected; it is not an alias for D.Lgs. 196/2003.
reason: Normattiva does not publish Regulation (EU) 2016/679. Mapping gdpr to the Italian privacy code makes testo gdpr --articolo 13 return the wrong law. The privacy-code aliases stay codice privacy, codice della privacy, and privacy.
validated_outcome: TestLookupFonte rejects gdpr and ParseCitation names codice privacy.
